metadata.title: Secure Survey

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for conducting surveys and feedback collection in a manner that is trustworthy, privacy‑respecting, ethically governed, and institutionally defensible.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Survey platforms, feedback systems, response storage, anonymization controls, data protection mechanisms, and ethics oversight processes.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Composite pattern asserting that all trust requirements for secure, ethical survey operations are satisfied.

metadata.remarks: Secure Survey is a composite trust pattern asserting that surveys are conducted as intentional, ethical, and defensible institutional activities. It introduces no independent controls and exists solely as an aggregate trust claim for solution architecture, risk analysis, and SSPP inheritance.

components.title: Survey Core
components.description: Baseline trust assumptions for survey solicitation and response collection.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Improper collection of personal or identifying information via deceptive survey solicitation.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Enforcement of approved survey purposes, scope, and solicitation rules.

components.title: Survey Identity and Anonymity
components.description: Defensible handling of respondent identity, anonymity guarantees, and re‑identification risk.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Inference or exposure of individual responses through linkage or re‑identification.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Separation, aggregation, and suppression mechanisms reducing re‑identification risk.

components.title: Survey Data Protection
components.description: Protection of collected survey responses against misuse, disclosure, and inappropriate secondary use.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Exfiltration or unauthorized reuse of collected survey data.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Access controls, encryption, and lifecycle restrictions for survey responses.

components.title: Survey Consent and Ethics
components.description: Informed consent, voluntariness, withdrawal rights, and ethical oversight.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Manipulation or suppression of consent, opt‑out, or withdrawal mechanisms.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Transparent, auditable enforcement of consent and ethics requirements.
